projection.selected_view_limitation: The SQL selected-result view does not encode the Python projector's unusable Tier 2 label-AcroForm penalty. It is therefore a provenance proxy, not a byte-identity oracle.

resolver.multiple_yearless_candidate_behavior: pickCandidates returns null before UNKNOWN_YEAR_SENTINEL assignment
resolver.adams_state_root_cause: Download-link year evidence is discarded; multiple yearless candidates are rejected. The cause is not an UNKNOWN_YEAR_SENTINEL guard.
resolver.safe_fix_direction: Inherit year from link text/path/parent context before candidate selection; do not emit multiple sentinel rows that collide on school/year uniqueness.
resolver.well_known_path_scope: Production applies well-known paths to direct-document hints; the audit separately evaluated the same paths for failed homepage hints.

ipeds_facts_direct_reader_inventory.interpretation: The public school-page path does not bypass the materialized current-facts serving layer. Historical/API examples and bounded tooling intentionally query ipeds_facts directly and must remain tightly filtered.

finance.negative_contract: A negative raw value with a matching value label becomes a status fact; an unlabeled negative remains numeric.
finance.accounting_failure_effect: Derived draw rate is excluded; raw components remain available.

producer_version_history.discipline_conclusion: Sequential history does not prove that every cleaner change and version bump occurred in the same commit.

consumer_contracts.admissions: web/src/lib/public-data.ts withholds incoherent friendly admissions values and emits low_confidence_extract; the underlying browser row remains queryable.
consumer_contracts.artifact_projection_parity: Exact equality is not a valid invariant: the spreadsheet/download corpus can include historical artifacts while browser projection is intentionally current-year scoped and applies its own selector. Per-document selected artifact identity is the appropriate contract, but projection rows do not currently persist it.
